post_hoc: [MEASURE] POST-HOC (2026-10-29): in-memory replay of E6 and a re-derivation of its BBSE-implied answered-set composition against the head's S_train prior (audit 2026-10 BBSE-1). experiments/out/E6_composition.json is unchanged and keeps the rho-only multiplier. The BBSE-implied view is an estimated, label-shift-tagged diagnostic; no certified quantity descends from this file.
formula: released: odds_t = rho_point * odds_head, with rho_point = odds(pi_t)/odds(clip(pi_source)) and pi_source the record-pooled S_aux prevalence. corrected: odds_t = odds_multiplier * odds_head, with odds_multiplier = rho_point * odds(clip(pi_source))/odds(pi_train) = odds(pi_t)/odds(pi_train) and pi_train = train.y.mean(), the S_train prevalence the logistic head's odds carry. clip is to [PI_CLIP, 1 - PI_CLIP], as rho_box_interval clips it. Both views average p_t = odds_t/(1 + odds_t) over the answered records.
